    L <+: mvcc.histShape ilog pend) : L <+: ilog

def mvcc.entryLess_dec : DecidableRel mvcc.entryLess :=
  go.goStringLt_dec a.snd.fst b.snd.fst

def mvcc.rangeAnswers (log : mvcc.Log) (endNil : Bool) (k e : GoString) (atRev : w64) : List
    (GoString × mvcc.Rev × w64 × w64) :=
  if endNil = true then
    match mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k) atRev with
    | some r => [(k, r)]
    | none => []
  else mvcc.rangeAt (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf log)) k e atRev

theorem mvcc.evsOfRev_sub (m : Nat) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (j : Nat) (e : mvcc.Ev) : (mvcc.evsOfRev
    m cs)[j]? = some e → e.rev.sub = W64 ↑j ∧ j < cs.length

    mvcc.histOf log) (hcount : (mvcc.evsOf log).length ≤ (mvcc.evsOfHist h).length) : mvcc.evsOfHist
    h = mvcc.evsOf log

theorem mvcc.rangeTaken_true (log : mvcc.Log) (k e : GoString) (atRev limit : w64) : mvcc.rangeTaken
    log true k e atRev limit = mvcc.rangeAnswers log true k e atRev

theorem mvcc.histOfFrom.eq_def (x✝ : Nat) (x✝¹ : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.histOfFrom x✝ x✝¹ = match x✝, x✝¹
    with | x, [] => [] | i, cs :: log => List.map mvcc.HistItem.ev (mvcc.evsOfRev i cs) ++
    [mvcc.HistItem.commit] ++ mvcc.histOfFrom (i + 1) log

def mvcc.histShape (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : List mvcc.HistItem :=
  mvcc.histOf ilog ++ List.map mvcc.HistItem.ev (mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length ilog) pend)

def mvcc.IdxEntry : Type :=
  Loc × GoString × mvcc.KeyIndex

    ++ t) = List.take m A

def mvcc.KiHead (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : Prop :=
  ki = mvcc.kiEmpty ∨ (ki.gens.headD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []

    mvcc.KiHead (mvcc.kiFold ki es k)

theorem mvcc.histOfFrom_prefix (i : Nat) (log ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) :
    mvcc.histOfFrom i log <+: mvcc.histOfFrom i ilog ++ List.map mvcc.HistItem.ev (mvcc.evsOfRev (i
    + List.length ilog) pend) → i + List.length ilog < 2 ^ 63 → ∃ rest, mvcc.evsOfHist
    (mvcc.histOfFrom i ilog ++ List.map mvcc.HistItem.ev (mvcc.evsOfRev (i + List.length ilog)
    pend)) = mvcc.evsOfFrom i log ++ rest ∧ mvcc.EvsFrom (i + List.length log) rest ∧ List.length
    log ≤ List.length ilog

    evs → (z.snd.gens.headD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []

    mvcc.idxOfEntries (L.set i z') = List.set (mvcc.idxOfEntries L) i (z'.snd.fst, z'.snd.snd)

    L)

    mvcc.kiItemLess (q, k) (mvcc.itemsOfEntries L) = mvcc.itemsOfEntries (mvcc.fromKey L k)

structure mvcc.EvsFrom (b : Nat) (es : List mvcc.Ev) : Prop where
  ge : b ≤ BitVec.toNat e.rev.main
  lt : BitVec.toNat e.rev.main < 2 ^ 63
  sorted : List.Pairwise (fun a c => BitVec.toNat a.rev.main ≤ BitVec.toNat c.rev.main) es

theorem mvcc.indexOf_sorted (evs : List mvcc.Ev) : List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess (mvcc.indexOf evs)

theorem mvcc.evsOfHist_append (h1 h2 : List mvcc.HistItem) : mvcc.evsOfHist (h1 ++ h2) =
    mvcc.evsOfHist h1 ++ mvcc.evsOfHist h2

theorem mvcc.kiGet_fold_below (k : GoString) (es : List mvcc.Ev) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (b : Nat) :
    mvcc.KiWf ki → (∀ (rev : mvcc.Rev), rev ∈ mvcc.kiRevs ki → BitVec.toNat rev.main ≤ b) → b < 2 ^
    63 → mvcc.EvsFrom b es → ∀ (r : Nat), r < b → mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiFold ki es k) (W64 ↑r) =
    mvcc.kiGet ki (W64 ↑r)

def mvcc.belowEnd (e : GoString) (z : mvcc.IdxEntry) : Bool :=
  decide (e = []) || decide (go.GoStringLt z.snd.fst e)

theorem mvcc.btInsert_set_entry (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) : List.Pairwise mvcc.entryLess L → ∀ (i :
    Nat) (z z' : mvcc.IdxEntry), L[i]? = some z → z'.snd.fst = z.snd.fst → btInsert mvcc.entryLess
    z' L = L.set i z'

def mvcc.kiItemLess_dec : DecidableRel mvcc.kiItemLess :=
  go.goStringLt_dec a.snd b.snd

theorem mvcc.mem_keys_iff (evs : List mvcc.Ev) (key : GoString) : key ∈ List.map Prod.fst
    (mvcc.indexOf evs) ↔ mvcc.kiOfKey evs key ≠ mvcc.kiEmpty

    j < G.length), j ≤ i → p G[j] = true) → (List.takeWhile p G)[i]? = G[i]?

def mvcc.instInhabitedHistItem : Inhabited mvcc.HistItem :=
  { default := mvcc.instInhabitedHistItem.default }

def mvcc.entryLess (a b : mvcc.IdxEntry) : Prop :=
  go.GoStringLt a.snd.fst b.snd.fst

theorem mvcc.reader_range (log₀ ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hcmp : mvcc.histOf log₀
    <+: mvcc.histShape ilog pend ∨ mvcc.histShape ilog pend <+: mvcc.histOf log₀) (hcount :
    (mvcc.evsOf log₀).length ≤ (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])).length) (hlen : List.length ilog < 2 ^
    63) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' log₀) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log₀ → cs.length < 2 ^ 63)
    (k e : GoString) (r : Nat) (hr : r < List.length log₀) : mvcc.rangeAt (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf
    (ilog ++ [pend]))) k e (W64 ↑r) = mvcc.rangeAt (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf log₀)) k e (W64 ↑r)

theorem mvcc.totalOf_succ (lim : Option Nat) (withTotal : Bool) (n : Nat) (h : withTotal = true ∨
    mvcc.reached lim n = false) : mvcc.totalOf lim withTotal (n + 1) = mvcc.totalOf lim withTotal n
    + 1

def mvcc.evsOfHist (h : List mvcc.HistItem) : List mvcc.Ev :=
  List.filterMap
    (fun x =>
      match x with
      | mvcc.HistItem.ev e => some e
      | mvcc.HistItem.commit => none)
    h

theorem mvcc.keys_sorted (evs : List mvcc.Ev) : List.Pairwise go.GoStringLt (List.map Prod.fst
    (mvcc.indexOf evs))

theorem mvcc.histOfFrom_prefix_shape_log (i : Nat) (L ilog : mvcc.Log) (E : List mvcc.HistItem) : (∀
    (x : mvcc.HistItem), x ∈ E → x ≠ mvcc.HistItem.commit) → mvcc.histOfFrom i L <+: mvcc.histOfFrom
    i ilog ++ E → L <+: ilog

theorem mvcc.histShape_seal (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : mvcc.histShape ilog pend
    ++ [mvcc.HistItem.commit] = mvcc.histOf (ilog ++ [pend])

theorem mvcc.histOfFrom_append (i : Nat) (log : mvcc.Log) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : mvcc.histOfFrom
    i (log ++ [cs]) = mvcc.histOfFrom i log ++ List.map mvcc.HistItem.ev (mvcc.evsOfRev (i +
    List.length log) cs) ++ [mvcc.HistItem.commit]

theorem mvcc.Rev.lt_zero_of_pos (m s : Nat) (h0 : 1 ≤ m) (hm : m < 2 ^ 63) : mvcc.Rev.zero.lt { main
    := W64 ↑m, sub := W64 ↑s }

theorem mvcc.EvsFrom.evsOfFrom (i : Nat) (log : mvcc.Log) : i + List.length log < 2 ^ 63 →
    mvcc.EvsFrom i (mvcc.evsOfFrom i log)

def mvcc.reached (lim : Option Nat) (n : Nat) : Bool :=
  match lim with
  | some m => decide (m ≤ n)
  | none => false

theorem mvcc.EvsFrom.mono {b b' : Nat} {es : List mvcc.Ev} (h : mvcc.EvsFrom b es) (hb : b' ≤ b) :
    mvcc.EvsFrom b' es

def mvcc.fromKey (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (k : GoString) : List mvcc.IdxEntry :=
  List.filter (fun z => !decide (go.GoStringLt z.snd.fst k)) L

theorem mvcc.KiHead.kiOfKey (evs : List mvcc.Ev) (k : GoString) : mvcc.KiHead (mvcc.kiOfKey evs k)

def mvcc.evOfChange (m i : Nat) (c : mvcc.Change) : mvcc.Ev :=
  { rev := { main := W64 ↑m, sub := W64 ↑i }, change := c }

theorem mvcc.rangeTaken_false (log : mvcc.Log) (k e : GoString) (atRev limit : w64) :
    mvcc.rangeTaken log false k e atRev limit = mvcc.takeLimit (mvcc.limitOf limit)
    (mvcc.rangeAnswers log false k e atRev)

def mvcc.kiItemLess (a b : Loc × GoString) : Prop :=
  go.GoStringLt a.snd b.snd

theorem mvcc.evsOfRev_change (m : Nat) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : List.map mvcc.Ev.change
    (mvcc.evsOfRev m cs) = cs

def mvcc.rangeAt (idx : mvcc.IndexM) (k e : GoString) (atRev : w64) : List (GoString × mvcc.Rev ×
    w64 × w64) :=
  List.filterMap (fun z => Option.map (fun r => (z.fst, r)) (mvcc.kiGet z.snd atRev))
    (List.filter (fun z => mvcc.inRange k e z.fst) idx)

theorem mvcc.reader_prefix (log₀ ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hcmp : mvcc.histOf log₀
    <+: mvcc.histShape ilog pend ∨ mvcc.histShape ilog pend <+: mvcc.histOf log₀) (hcount :
    (mvcc.evsOf log₀).length ≤ (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])).length) (hlen : List.length ilog < 2 ^
    63) : ∃ rest, mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend]) = mvcc.evsOf log₀ ++ rest

def mvcc.limitOf (limit : w64) : Option Nat :=
  if 0 < sint.Z limit then some (sint.Z limit).toNat else none

def mvcc.rangeEntries (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (k e : GoString) : List mvcc.IdxEntry :=
  List.filter (fun z => mvcc.inRange k e z.snd.fst) L

theorem mvcc.takeLimit_of_prefix {α : Type} (lim : Option Nat) {A B : List α} (hp : A <+: B) (h :
    mvcc.reached lim A.length = true) : mvcc.takeLimit lim B = mvcc.takeLimit lim A

theorem mvcc.map_ev_ne_commit (es : List mvcc.Ev) (x : mvcc.HistItem) : x ∈ List.map
    mvcc.HistItem.ev es → x ≠ mvcc.HistItem.commit

theorem mvcc.evsOfFrom_main (i : Nat) (log : mvcc.Log) (e : mvcc.Ev) : e ∈ mvcc.evsOfFrom i log → ∃
    j, j < List.length log ∧ e.rev.main = W64 (↑i + ↑j)

theorem mvcc.idxGet_eq_find? (idx : mvcc.IndexM) (hs : List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx) (k :
    GoString) : mvcc.idxGet idx k = Option.map Prod.snd (List.find? (fun z => decide (z.fst = k))
    idx)

theorem mvcc.histOf_prefix_shape (log ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hpre : mvcc.histOf
    log <+: mvcc.histShape ilog pend) (hlen : List.length ilog < 2 ^ 63) : ∃ rest, mvcc.evsOf (ilog
    ++ [pend]) = mvcc.evsOf log ++ rest ∧ mvcc.EvsFrom (List.length log) rest ∧ List.length log ≤
    List.length ilog

theorem mvcc.entryAnswers_nil (atRev : w64) : mvcc.entryAnswers [] atRev = []

theorem mvcc.kiGet_reader (log ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hpre : mvcc.histOf log
    <+: mvcc.histShape ilog pend) (hlen : List.length ilog < 2 ^ 63) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' log) (hcs :
    ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (k : GoString) (r : Nat) (hr : r <
    List.length log) : mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])) k) (W64 ↑r) =
    mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k) (W64 ↑r)

theorem mvcc.takeWhile_eq_take {α : Type} (p : α → Bool) (G : List α) (i : Nat) : (∀ (j : Nat) (h :
    j < G.length), j < i → p G[j] = true) → i ≤ G.length → (i = G.length ∨ ∃ h, p G[i] = false) →
    List.takeWhile p G = List.take i G

theorem mvcc.histOf_prefix_log {L1 L2 : mvcc.Log} (h : mvcc.histOf L1 <+: mvcc.histOf L2) : L1 <+:
    L2

def mvcc.evsOfFrom (i : Nat) (log : mvcc.Log) : List mvcc.Ev :=
  (List.map (fun p => mvcc.evsOfRev p.snd p.fst) (List.zipIdx log i)).flatten

theorem mvcc.evsOf_eq_evsOfFrom (log : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.evsOf log = mvcc.evsOfFrom 0 log

theorem mvcc.rangeTotal_true (log : mvcc.Log) (k e : GoString) (atRev limit : w64) (wt : Bool) :
    mvcc.rangeTotal log true k e atRev limit wt = (mvcc.rangeAnswers log true k e atRev).length

theorem mvcc.find?_entry_getElem? (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (k : GoString) (z : mvcc.IdxEntry) (h :
    List.find? (fun z => decide (z.snd.fst = k)) L = some z) : ∃ i, L[i]? = some z ∧ z.snd.fst = k

theorem mvcc.KiHead.apply {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (h : mvcc.KiHead ki) (e : mvcc.Ev) : mvcc.KiHead
    (mvcc.kiApply ki e)

theorem mvcc.evOfChange_del (m i : Nat) (k : GoString) : mvcc.evOfChange m i (mvcc.Change.del k) = {
    rev := { main := W64 ↑m, sub := W64 ↑i }, change := mvcc.Change.del k }

theorem mvcc.evsOfHist_histOfFrom (i : Nat) (log : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.evsOfHist (mvcc.histOfFrom i
    log) = mvcc.evsOfFrom i log

theorem mvcc.rangeAnswers_nil (log : mvcc.Log) (k e : GoString) (atRev : w64) : mvcc.rangeAnswers
    log true k e atRev = (Option.map (fun r => (k, r)) (mvcc.kiGet (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k)
    atRev)).toList

def mvcc.itemsOfEntries (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) : List (Loc × GoString) :=
  List.map (fun z => (z.fst, z.snd.fst)) L

theorem mvcc.evsOfHist_histOf (log : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.evsOfHist (mvcc.histOf log) = mvcc.evsOf log

def mvcc.idxOfEntries (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) : mvcc.IndexM :=
  List.map (fun z => (z.snd.fst, z.snd.snd)) L

theorem mvcc.btInsert_idx_set (L : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (hs : List.Pairwise mvcc.kiItemLess
    (mvcc.itemsOfEntries L)) (i : Nat) (z : mvcc.IdxEntry) (hz : ∃ h, L[i] = z) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex)
    : btInsert mvcc.idxLess (z.snd.fst, ki) (mvcc.idxOfEntries L) = mvcc.idxOfEntries (L.set i
    (z.fst, z.snd.fst, ki))

theorem mvcc.head_ne_fold (k : GoString) (es : List mvcc.Ev) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : (ki.gens.headD
    mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ [] → ((mvcc.kiFold ki es k).gens.headD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []

theorem mvcc.kiApply_revs {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (e : mvcc.Ev) (r : mvcc.Rev) : r
    ∈ mvcc.kiRevs (mvcc.kiApply ki e) → r ∈ mvcc.kiRevs ki ∨ r = e.rev

def mvcc.instInhabitedHistItem.default : mvcc.HistItem :=
  mvcc.HistItem.commit

theorem mvcc.kiFold_cons (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (e : mvcc.Ev) (es : List mvcc.Ev) (k : GoString) :
    mvcc.kiFold ki (e :: es) k = mvcc.kiFold (if e.key = k then mvcc.kiApply ki e else ki) es k

theorem mvcc.btFind_sorted_eq_find? {V : Type} (keyf : V → GoString) (less : V → V → Prop)
    [DecidableRel less] (hless : ∀ (a b : V), less a b ↔ go.GoStringLt (keyf a) (keyf b)) (l : List
    V) : List.Pairwise go.GoStringLt (List.map keyf l) → ∀ (x : V), btFind less x l = List.find?
    (fun y => decide (keyf y = keyf x)) l

theorem mvcc.totalOf_reached (lim : Option Nat) (n N : Nat) (hn : n ≤ N) (h : mvcc.reached lim n =
    true) : mvcc.totalOf lim false N = mvcc.totalOf lim false n

theorem mvcc.take_of_prefix {α : Type} {A B : List α} (h : A <+: B) (m : Nat) (hm : m ≤ A.length) :
    List.take m B = List.take m A

def mvcc.rangeTotal (log : mvcc.Log) (endNil : Bool) (k e : GoString) (atRev limit : w64) (withTotal
    : Bool) : Nat :=
  if endNil = true then (mvcc.rangeAnswers log endNil k e atRev).length
  else mvcc.totalOf (mvcc.limitOf limit) withTotal (mvcc.rangeAnswers log endNil k e atRev).length

theorem mvcc.takeLimit_append_not {α : Type} (lim : Option Nat) (A : List α) (a : α) (h :
    mvcc.reached lim A.length = false) : mvcc.takeLimit lim (A ++ [a]) = mvcc.takeLimit lim A ++ [a]

def mvcc.kiAt (idx : mvcc.IndexM) (key : GoString) : mvcc.KeyIndex :=
  (mvcc.idxGet idx key).getD mvcc.kiEmpty

def mvcc.entryAnswers (G : List mvcc.IdxEntry) (atRev : w64) : List (GoString × mvcc.Rev × w64 ×
    w64) :=
  List.filterMap (fun z => Option.map (fun r => (z.snd.fst, r)) (mvcc.kiGet z.snd.snd atRev)) G

theorem mvcc.kiFold_modified_lt (k : GoString) (rev : mvcc.Rev) (es : List mvcc.Ev) (ki :
    mvcc.KeyIndex) : ki.modified.lt rev → (∀ (e : mvcc.Ev), e ∈ es → e.rev.lt rev) → (mvcc.kiFold ki
    es k).modified.lt rev

theorem mvcc.evsOfFrom_cons (i : Nat) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (log : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.evsOfFrom i
    (cs :: log) = mvcc.evsOfRev i cs ++ mvcc.evsOfFrom (i + 1) log

theorem mvcc.nodup_of_sorted {l : List GoString} (h : List.Pairwise go.GoStringLt l) : l.Nodup

theorem mvcc.histOf_cmp_log {L1 L2 : mvcc.Log} (h : mvcc.histOf L1 <+: mvcc.histOf L2 ∨ mvcc.histOf
    L2 <+: mvcc.histOf L1) : L1 <+: L2 ∨ L2 <+: L1

theorem mvcc.sublist_of_subset_sorted (S T : List GoString) : List.Pairwise go.GoStringLt S →
    List.Pairwise go.GoStringLt T → (∀ (x : GoString), x ∈ S → x ∈ T) → S.Sublist T

theorem mvcc.kiLastEmpty_false_of_del (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (k : GoString)
    (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' (ilog ++ [pend])) (hwf' : mvcc.LogWf' (ilog ++ [pend ++ [mvcc.Change.del
    k]])) (hlen : List.length ilog + 1 < 2 ^ 63) (hilog : 1 ≤ List.length ilog) (hpend : pend.length
    < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ ilog → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) : mvcc.kiLastEmpty
    (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])) k) = false

def mvcc.totalOf (lim : Option Nat) (withTotal : Bool) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  match lim, withTotal with
  | some m, false => min n m
  | x, x_1 => n

theorem mvcc.prefix_commit_split (A B X Y : List mvcc.HistItem) : (∀ (x : mvcc.HistItem), x ∈ A → x
    ≠ mvcc.HistItem.commit) → (∀ (x : mvcc.HistItem), x ∈ B → x ≠ mvcc.HistItem.commit) → A ++
    [mvcc.HistItem.commit] ++ X <+: B ++ [mvcc.HistItem.commit] ++ Y → A = B ∧ X <+: Y

theorem mvcc.filterMap_congr' {α β : Type} {f g : α → Option β} (l : List α) : (∀ (x : α), x ∈ l → f
    x = g x) → List.filterMap f l = List.filterMap g l

theorem mvcc.map_ev_injective (es1 es2 : List mvcc.Ev) : List.map mvcc.HistItem.ev es1 = List.map
    mvcc.HistItem.ev es2 → es1 = es2

def mvcc.rangeTaken (log : mvcc.Log) (endNil : Bool) (k e : GoString) (atRev limit : w64) : List
    (GoString × mvcc.Rev × w64 × w64) :=
  if endNil = true then mvcc.rangeAnswers log endNil k e atRev
  else mvcc.takeLimit (mvcc.limitOf limit) (mvcc.rangeAnswers log endNil k e atRev)

theorem mvcc.head_ne_apply {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (h : (ki.gens.headD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []) (e :
    mvcc.Ev) : ((mvcc.kiApply ki e).gens.headD mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []

theorem mvcc.evsOfHist_commit : mvcc.evsOfHist [mvcc.HistItem.commit] = []

theorem mvcc.evsOfRev_append_singleton (m : Nat) (cs : List mvcc.Change) (c : mvcc.Change) :
    mvcc.evsOfRev m (cs ++ [c]) = mvcc.evsOfRev m cs ++ [mvcc.evOfChange m cs.length c]

theorem mvcc.evsOf_append_change (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (c : mvcc.Change) :
    mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend ++ [c]]) = mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend]) ++ [mvcc.evOfChange
    (List.length ilog) pend.length c]
